old: At the B1 milestone, speakers seamlessly combine temporal (*miután, mielőtt*), causal (*mivel, azért mert*), conditional (*ha... volna*), concessive (*bár... mégis*), and reported speech clauses into articulate, multi-tiered sentences.
new: You know all of these from earlier units: time clauses with *miután* and *mielőtt* (B1 Unit 1), causal *mivel* and *mert* (A1 Unit 24), concessive *bár... mégis* (B1 Unit 9), the past conditional *ha... volna* (B1 Unit 39) and reported speech (B1 Unit 25). At the B1 milestone, speakers seamlessly combine them in longer, multi-tiered sentences.
why: a synthesis screen recapping earlier units must say they are known, with the unit numbers from the knowledge sheet
